show.description: When a powerful yet disguised billionaire businesswoman is mistaken for a waitress by a rival CEO, it sparks a chain of comical misunderstandings, heartbreaks, and power shifts — until love and identity collide, revealing that the woman everyone underestimated is, in fact, the formidable “Sky Queen” of the global Deemar Group.
